whatIs.title: What is the Regex Extractor?
whatIs.description: Extract patterns, filter matching lines or replace text. Regular expressions run in a Worker with cancellation, errors and limits. Partial results are not presented as complete, and a retained successful result is distinguished from the current input.

howToUse.title: How to Use
items: Choose an operation, pattern and flags, then enter text or select a preset. Changes run automatically after an approximately 300ms delay.
Cancel a slow task. The same canceled input is not immediately rerun; retry explicitly or edit the input.
Check the result status and full length. Preview shows at most 50,000 UTF-16 units; full copy and TXT export use the complete successful string.
Files are limited to 4 MiB and decoded input to 1,000,000 UTF-16 units. Limits also apply to patterns at 10,000, replacements at 100,000, output at 4,000,000 units, and scanned matches at 100,000.
Input and patterns may be reflected in the existing URL. Overlong links are not silently truncated. Use TXT to export the full result.

items.q: How do cancellation and the five-second limit work?
items.a: Cancellation terminates the active Worker. Five seconds is a stopping threshold, not a strict wall-clock guarantee in all environments because background timers may be delayed. Hiding or leaving the page cancels the task, and returning does not automatically resume it.

items.q: Can a pattern match an empty string?
items.a: After an empty match, processing advances to the next position and handles the final position once. Unicode mode advances by code point without splitting surrogate pairs.

items.q: How are capture groups included in extraction?
items.a: With g, output contains the full-match list. Without g, extraction preserves the existing JavaScript match meaning: the first full match followed by its capture groups.

items.q: Can replacements use captures and dollar signs?
items.a: JavaScript replacement semantics for captures, full matches, named captures, dollar signs and surrounding context are preserved. If output exceeds the limit, partial content is not marked as successful.

items.q: Is only the visible preview exported?
items.a: No. The full successful result is distinct from its preview, and full copy or TXT uses the complete string. A previous successful result is labeled when the current input fails or is canceled.

items.q: What if a Worker cannot start?
items.a: An error and retry option are shown. Slow regular expressions are not rerun synchronously on the main screen.

status.idle: Enter a pattern to process text.
status.canceled: Processing stopped. Select retry to run it again.
status.previous: This result belongs to earlier input, not the current input.
status.empty: Processing completed with an empty string.

errors.replacementTooLarge: Replacement text is limited to 100,000 characters.
errors.invalidRegex: The pattern or flags are invalid or unsupported by this browser.
errors.outputTooLarge: The complete result exceeds 4,000,000 characters. Narrow the pattern or input. No partial result was exported.
errors.tooManyMatches: The scan exceeded 100,000 matches. Narrow the pattern or input.
errors.unsupported: This browser cannot run a separate processing worker.
errors.workerFailed: The task could not start or finish. Your input was kept; try again.
errors.invalidResponse: The task result could not be verified. Try again.
errors.timeout: Processing took too long and was stopped (5-second target). Narrow the pattern or input, then retry.
errors.fileFailed: The file could not be read. Current input was kept.
errors.saveFailed: History could not be saved. Input and results were kept; retry or download TXT.

execution.limits: Input 1,000,000 characters · pattern 10,000 · replacement 100,000 · output 4,000,000 · scan matches 100,000 · file 4MiB. Lengths use UTF-16 units; some emoji count as 2.
execution.preview: Showing the first {shown} of {total} characters. Complete copy and TXT use the entire successful result.
execution.detailPreview: Match details are previews: first 5 matches, 20,000 characters overall, 2,000 per field and 20 captures. Complete output and total match count remain separate.
execution.detailTruncated: Only part of this detail is shown.

copy.failed: Copy failed. Select the complete text below manually or retry.
copy.selectionFailed: Automatic selection was unavailable. Select the text manually to copy it.
copy.downloadFailed: TXT download could not start. The result was kept.

url.tooLong: The current input link exceeds 16,384 characters, so link sharing is disabled. Earlier regex input was removed from the address. Download the complete result as TXT.
url.invalidInput: This input cannot be linked. Earlier regex input was removed from the address.
url.invalidEncoding: This text cannot be represented exactly in a link, so link sharing is disabled. Your original text was kept.
url.malformedEncoding: Some link encoding could not be decoded. Those strings were kept unchanged.
url.invalidOperation: The link operation was not recognized. The default operation is shown.
url.invalidTransform: The link transformation was not recognized. A regular expression operation is shown.
url.duplicateParameter: The link contains repeated parameters; the first value was read.
url.notice: Shared links contain the pattern, input and replacement text. Review the contents before sharing.
url.writeFailed: The address could not be updated, so link sharing is disabled. It may still contain earlier input. Keep your current input and edit again, or use TXT.
